_comments.observations: List of input features for the PPO agent.

agent_params.actor_lr: Learning rate for the actor network.
agent_params.critic_lr: Learning rate for the critic network.
agent_params.entropy_coef: Initial entropy coefficient for exploration regularization.
agent_params.ppo_epochs: Number of PPO epochs per rollout.
agent_params.hidden_size: Number of neurons in each hidden layer.
agent_params.hidden_layers: Number of hidden layers in the network.
agent_params.lambda_ewc: EWC regularization strength (set to 0.0 to disable EWC).
agent_params.lambda_si: Synaptic Intelligence (SI) regularization strength (set to 0.0 to disable SI).
agent_params.epsilon_si: Stability parameter for SI (must be > 0 if SI is active; ignored if SI is disabled).
agent_params.lambda_mas: MAS regularization strength (set to 0.0 to disable MAS).
agent_params.lambda_lwf: LwF (Learning without Forgetting) regularization strength (set to 0.0 to disable LwF).
agent_params.lambda_wd: Weight decay (L2 regularization) strength (set to 0.0 to disable L2 regularization).
agent_params.early_stopping_patience: Number of rollouts with no improvement before early stopping.
agent_params.min_delta: Minimum reward improvement to reset early stopping patience.

_comments.model_dir: Directory where trained model weights are saved.
